name: Mojácar (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly, yellow above and blue below, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mojácar (a black double-headed eagle bearing a shield).
history: Municipal flag of Mojácar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Mojácar arms — black double-headed eagle with a shield
